title: How a Man of God Stays the Same Guy When the Room Changes
caption:
Church guy. Gym guy. The guy your friends see and the guy alone at 1 a.m.

If you can list off the versions you run, you already know how many there are. And the hidden one, the one that shows up when nobody's grading you, is closer to who you actually are than any of the rest.

One man of God, every room. Save this for the room you keep hiding.

#faith #integrity #manofgod #christianmen #accountability
